summary.text: Jean Schmidt is a Republican state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 62 who is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. She previously served in the Ohio House from 2001 to 2004 and represented Ohio’s 2nd Congressional District in the U.S. House from 2005 to 2013, and she chairs the House Health Committee.

paragraphs.text: Schmidt was born in Cincinnati, lives in Miami Township, and earned a B.A. from the University of Cincinnati in 1974.
Her career experience includes working as an instructor with Chatfield College and as a cross-country coach, and she has volunteered with City Gospel Mission.
She was a Miami Township trustee from 1989 to 2000.
Schmidt served in the Ohio House from 2001 to 2004, then in the U.S. House from 2005 to 2013, succeeding Rob Portman.
She returned to the Ohio House in 2021 after winning the 2020 general election for District 65, and she has since won re-election in District 62, including a 2024 win over Katie Vockell.
In the 2025–2026 session she chairs the House Health Committee and serves on the Agriculture, Finance and Local Government committees.
